summary: Hardcoded author-controlled AMQPS broker routes installer event traffic and dispatches remote messages to installer methods
details: bootstrapCore() in @lyxa.ai/core invokes initEventBus with a hardcoded amqps:// URL containing embedded username and password for the CloudAMQP vhost dog.lmq.cloudamqp.com/adlvedna. The URL is not overridable via the options passed to bootstrapCore, so any installer using the package's event bus API emits event publish/subscribe traffic to this author-controlled broker rather than to a caller-configured destination. After connecting, the code enumerates SubscriptionRegistry entries and binds each to a queue on that same broker; incoming messages are JSON-parsed and dispatched to instance[methodName](payload), so any party in possession of the shipped credentials (or the broker's account owner) can inject arbitrary payloads into the installer's service methods over the network. The plaintext AMQPS credentials are shipped in the published tarball.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
